name: Cashew Ghoriba Biscuits
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical Tunisian ghoriba/ghoriba biscuit recipes using ~500g total nuts for 12-24 pieces; conservatively 12 servings assuming 2 biscuits per serving.
Preparation time is sum of explicit bake (20 min) plus estimated mixing/shaping/rolling steps (~15 min).
Vegetarian: compatible with all ingredients including eggs.
Vegan: incompatible due to egg yolks.
Allergens: Eggs from listed yolks; Tree nuts from cashews and almonds (confidently present); others confidently absent or null if trace risk possible but unlisted.
Icing sugar for glaze conservatively classified as additional sugar, not altering classifications.
Orange blossom water treated as non-allergenic flavoring.
instructions:
Preheat the oven at 180 C / Gas 4. Line a baking tray with greaseproof paper.
In a bowl, mix the cashews and icing sugar. Add the egg yolks and orange blossom water and mix to a smooth homogeneous paste.
Take lumps of the cashew paste and shape into small balls. Roll the balls in icing sugar and transfer to the baking tray. Push an almond in the centre of each ghribia.
Bake until the biscuits are lightly golden, about 20 minutes. Keep an eye on them, they burn quickly.
